When you edit a test file and the edit loosens assertions (lower thresholds,

Report to Tom: what the test expected vs what the code returned.

**Purpose:** rotation, not suppression. A node has 10 connections. Without fatigue, always the same 3 show. With fatigue, after those 3 surface, the next 3 get a turn.

**Formula:**
```
edge_score = relevance(query_vec, target_embedding) × weight × (1 / (1 + K_edge × surface_count))
```
K_edge = 0.25 (Tom confirmed). First show full, fifth show ~

examples.title: Decode pipeline: proximity + traversal + precision feedback loop
examples.content_snippet:
The full decode architecture we designed:
1. PROXIMITY: embedding similarity finds seed nodes (current)
2. TRAVERSAL: follow edges using relation types to pull connected clusters, not just 1-hop neighbors. If you find "Anchor decision" → follow produced/validates/evolved_from edges to get the reasoning chain
3. PRECISION FEEDBACK: successful recall query → store as enrichment vector on matched nod

examples.title: Future: lazy decay on access replaces batch prune pass
examples.content_snippet:
Current design: batch decay_edges() runs in idle maintenance, iterates all edges, applies exponential decay, prunes below threshold.

Future design (requires in-memory graph): decay is a computed property. When you access an edge, its effective weight = stored_weight * 0.5^(hours_since_reinforced / half_life). No batch pass needed. The edge 'dies' when its effective weight drops below threshold on

examples.content_snippet: Every node type has a half-life in hours. decision/rule/procedure/fn_reasoning/param_influence/arch_constraint/bug_lesson = infinity (never decay). context = 24h, thought = 3h, intuition = 12h. Time-dilation (decay_active_rate, decay_idle_rate) further modifies ef

examples.title: [param] personal='fixed' — zero decay, auto-locked, permanent facts
examples.content_snippet: When personal='fixed': (1) remember() forces locked=True, (2) decay function skips Ebbinghaus retention entirely (retention=1.0 always), (3) node survives indefinitely regardless of type's half-life. Use for: birthday, family, identity, role. Same effect as locked=True but semantically distinct — locked means 'confirmed decision', fixed means 'permanent personal fact'.
